title: Path of Exile 1 — The Exile's Journey
subtitle: 1599 IC — Exile washes ashore on the cursed continent

cards.title: Banished from Oriath (1599 IC)
cards.text: High Templar Dominus rules Oriath with an iron fist. He secretly studies thaumaturgy — patronizing Piety, creating Miscreations. Exiles are chained, thrown on ships, cast to the place "from which none return."
cards.flavorText: "Order through strength. Strength through faith. Faith through me." — Dominus

cards.title: Piety & The Godless Three's Legacy
cards.text: Dominus sends Piety (real name Vinia) to Wraeclast to study the Godless Three's legacy. Act 1: Shavronne's work (creating Brutus). Act 2: Maligaro's laboratory (creature transformation). Act 3: Malachai's lab (Lunaris Temple).
cards.flavorText: "Progress is not made by the many." — Piety

timeline.title: The Shore & The Forest
timeline.text: Exile washes ashore at Lioneye's Watch. Defeat Merveil — a siren cursed by the Star of Wraeclast. In the forest: confront Alira, Kraityn, Oak — three bandit lords. Explore Vaal ruins.
timeline.flavorText: "The sea takes everything. But sometimes, it gives back." — Nessa

timeline.title: Sarn — The Dead City
timeline.text: Meet Lady Dialla (Gemling Queen — 200+ years old). Infiltrate Lunaris Temple. Defeat Dominus Ascendant atop the Sceptre of God.
timeline.flavorText: "Not a cockroach. Not yet. But getting there." — Lady Dialla

timeline.title: ⚠️ Slaying The Beast
timeline.text: Enter The Beast. Piety sacrifices herself to help the Exile. Face the spirits of Kaom and Daresso in the Nightmare. Kill Malachai — The Beast dies — ALL gods awaken!
timeline.flavorText: "We killed the beast. But who will keep the gods asleep?" — Tasuni

timeline.title: 🔥 The Fall of Oriath
timeline.text: Return to Oriath. Kitava — the God of Hunger — rises and devours the island. Innocence is redeemed from High Templar Avarius. Exile loses first fight, all Resistances stripped.
timeline.flavorText: "King's Feast — the ancient rite when the conqueror devours the defeated. Two tribes become one." — Lani

timeline.title: Gods Awakened
timeline.text: Tukohama burns the forest. Brine King (Tsoagoth) kidnaps Nessa. Arakaali — Spider Goddess — consumes Silk. Sin guides the absorption of Divinity through the Pantheon.
timeline.flavorText: "Though I am a god, I don't forget my humanity. I care about what I once was." — Sin

timeline.title: War of the Gods
timeline.text: Defeat Solaris & Lunaris (divine sisters — manipulated against each other), Garukhan (Maraketh Wind Goddess), Shakari (Desert Goddess). Gather enough Divinity.
timeline.flavorText: "Ambition is the plague of mortals. It is ambition that puts us on divine thrones." — Sin

timeline.title: ⚔️ Defeat Kitava
timeline.text: Final battle in Oriath. Sin sacrifices his power to help defeat Kitava. Innocence fights alongside. Oriath is liberated but left in ruins.
timeline.flavorText: "In the end, even the hungry must learn to be full." — Sin

summary.title: POE 1 Conclusion
items: ✅ Innocence redeemed, Sin sacrificed his power
⚠️ The Elder & The Shaper — endgame threats from Atlas
